summary: Tested the new 'Nilai Aset Barang' (inventory asset value) feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/inventory/value (6 pytest tests) + frontend Dashboard card + Stok Opname panel for admin, hidden for kasir. All checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoint for /api/stok-opname: history records are permanent even after the referenced product is deleted, leaving orphan rows (observed TEST_Pupuk 1 / TEST_Neg entries). Consider adding admin-only delete or soft-delete for cleanup/auditing.

GET /api/inventory/value loads all products up to 5000 and iterates in Python (no DB-side aggregation). Fine for current scale but will not scale for large catalogs; consider a Mongo $group aggregation.
InventoryValuePanel.jsx fetches on refreshKey=history.length, so panel only refreshes when a NEW opname is added. If an opname is edited/deleted (future feature) this will not refresh.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture creates two TEST_ products + one TEST_ kasir user; all deleted on teardown. UI test created a transient TEST_ kasir user and deleted it. Pre-seeded TEST_Pupuk 1 (stok 5) and TEST_Pupuk 2 (stok 10) remain as expected per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified: Backend returns correct total {produk, unit, nilai_modal, nilai_jual, potensi_laba}, categories breakdown, items sorted by nilai_modal desc, negative stock treated as 0, kasir -> 403. Frontend: admin dashboard shows stat-inventory-value card (Rp 1.500.000) linking to /stok-opname; InventoryValuePanel on Stok Opname shows all 4 total cards, categories chip, product rows, Excel/PDF export buttons (Excel download confirmed as Nilai_Aset_Barang.xlsx). Kasir does NOT see the card nor the panel. Panel refreshes after opname save. Leftover TEST_ stok_opname history rows exist (no DELETE endpoint) but do not affect inventory_value computation.
